The generic JSON Schema validator receives the explicit external OpenAPI/JSON Schema graph selected by the caller, including a verified historical release graph. It does not invent or decode an application payload model, select another schema after refusal, or fall back to the current bundled graph.

Generic json.load/json.loads object-pairs hook checks duplicate JSON keys before any owning payload decoder. Both the result accumulator and return are the external JSON object format; the schema-selected owning callback validates the complete application document separately.

ObservationTransport is the acceptance bridge for a verified historical Controller release: LocalBrowserController.observation_request captures one ControllerContract before I/O and decodes records plus the full document through that exact release schema. This boundary forwards the original external source document unchanged, without trial decoders, current-contract fallback, or an independently authored application shape. The existing require_object application-read debt remains recorded separately.
